p: went on his journey: Or, "lifted up his feet".
and: Thus he was directed by the providence of God, who brought him to Laban's house.
brethren: It seems that in those days the custom was to call even strangers, brethren.
Is he well: Or, "he is in peace?" by which the Hebrews mean prosperity.
all these things: That is, the reason why he departed from his father's house, and what he saw during his journey.
bone and my flesh: That is, of my blood and kindred.
few days: Meaning after the years were accomplished.
it came to pass in the: The reason Jacob was deceived was that in ancient times the wife was covered with a veil, when she was brought to her husband as a sign of purity and humbleness.
It must not be so done: He valued the profit he had from Jacob's service more than either his promise or the customs of the country, though he used custom for his excuse.
opened her womb: This declares that often they who are despised by men are favoured by God.
LORD hath looked upon my affliction: By this it appears that she had sought help from God in her affliction.
love me: For children are a great cause of mutual love between man and wife.
